name: m-charts-monorepo
description: WebGL2 charting library for large datasets, with high-performance scatter, histogram, and parallel-coordinate interactions.

scripts.build:vercel: pnpm clean:data && pnpm generate:data:local && pnpm build
scripts.generate:data:local: pnpm generate:data -- --kind scatter-fast --count 1000000 --seed 1 --out apps/demo/public/data/scatter-fast-sample.json --schema-out apps/demo/public/data/scatter-fast-schema.json && pnpm generate:data -- --kind mixed-tables --count 1000000 --secondary-count 1000 --seed 1 --out apps/demo/public/data/mixed-table-fixture.json && pnpm generate:data -- --kind histogram-bars --seed 1 --out apps/demo/public/data/histogram-bars-sample.json && pnpm generate:data -- --kind scatter --count 1000000 --seed 1 --out apps/demo/public/data/scatter-sample.json && pnpm generate:data -- --kind parallel --count 100000 --seed 1 --out apps/demo/public/data/parallel-sample.json
